cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You shook the coffee tin so confidently, so I've shaken this cheap substitute. Have the first sip before I fill my cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was checking whether my tin was empty. We've still got proper coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, checking the supply. If you like this, we can keep the proper stuff for visitors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not spoiling my breakfast for an experiment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sip, then. If it's awful, I'll get you proper coffee and a croissant. Mine can stay empty until you tell me.
